title: Stochastic Inverse Problem: stability, regularization and Wasserstein gradient flow
abstract: arXiv:2410.00229v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Inverse problems in physical or biological sciences often involve recovering an unknown parameter that is random. The sought-after quantity is a probability distribution of the unknown parameter, that produces data that aligns with measurements. Consequently, these problems are naturally framed as stochastic inverse problems. In this paper, we explore three aspects of this problem: direct inversion, variational formulation with regularization, and optimization via gradient flows, drawing parallels with deterministic inverse problems. A key difference from the deterministic case is the space in which we operate. Here, we work within a probability space rather than Euclidean or Sobolev spaces, making tools from measure transport theory necessary for the study. translated_title: 随机逆问题：稳定性、正则化与Wasserstein梯度流
translated_abstract: 物理或生物科学中的逆问题通常涉及恢复一个随机的未知参数。所寻求的目标是未知参数的概率分布，该分布产生的数据与测量结果相一致。因此，这些问题自然地被构建为随机逆问题。本文从三个方面探讨这一问题：直接反演、带正则化的变分形式，以及通过梯度流进行优化，并与确定性逆问题进行类比。与确定性情形的一个关键区别在于我们所工作的空间。在这里，我们在概率空间而非欧几里得空间或Sobolev空间中进行研究，这使得测度输运理论的工具成为研究的必要手段。我们的研究结果表明，度量的选择——无论是在损失函数的设计中还是在优化过程中——对稳定性和问题的性质都有显著影响。
tldr: 本文将逆问题推广到随机情形，在概率空间中借助测度输运理论研究了直接反演、带正则化的变分方法以及Wasserstein梯度流优化，并揭示了度量选择对稳定性和解的性质的关键影响。
en_tdlr: This paper extends inverse problems to the stochastic setting, employing measure transport theory in probability space to study direct inversion, regularized variational formulations, and optimization via Wasserstein gradient flows, revealing that the choice of metric significantly impacts stability and solution properties.
